Missouri Secretary of State, Official Election Returns, General Election 2004, statewide totals (pdf)

method: Kansas City (Kansas City Board of Election Commissioners, the Jackson County part of the city) Governor votes transcribed from the official county-by-county returns PDF (text extracted with pdftotext; PDFs kept in data/raw/state/2004_MO_SEN_kc/) into one row added to Jackson County 29095; oth = Swenson (LIB) 1,416, Wells (CST) 613, write-in 0. Needed because Amlani & Algara's Missouri 2004 Governor county rows omit Kansas City (statewide shortfall equals Kansas City exactly).
validation: Amlani statewide dem 1,195,208 + KC 106,234 = 1,301,442 vs certified Claire McCaskill 1,301,442: +0 (+0.00%); Amlani statewide rep 1,350,134 + KC 32,285 = 1,382,419 vs certified Matt Blunt 1,382,419: +0 (+0.00%). KC row sums to the official KC total of 140,548.
